title: Cross-species atlas of bacterial RNA 3' ends reveals termination mechanistic signatures and evolutionary patterns.
abstract: Deciphering the generation mechanisms and regulatory roles of bacterial transcript 3' termini requires large-scale 3' terminus data. We repurpose PATHOgenex, an available RNAtag-seq dataset, leveraging RNAtag-seq-specific read patterns associated with 3' termini to generate the "Bacterminome" atlas, a rich resource of species- and condition-dependent transcript 3' termini of 32 bacterial human pathogens grown under 10-12 conditions. Analysis of sequence elements near 3' termini revealed, along with the classical intrinsic terminator, other known and newly detected signatures, highlighting the wealth of termination-associated sequence elements. Intriguingly, orthologous genes with corresponding 3' termini show different termination mechanisms in different bacteria, often matching the dominant mechanism of the respective bacterial species. Analysis of condition-dependent 3' termini revealed some conservation across species, supporting the conjecture that alternative 3' termini can play a role in gene expression regulation. Our resource, available through a user-friendly web server (https://bacterminome.huji.ac.il), provides a platform for studying transcription termination at an unprecedented scope.

summary.title_zh: 细菌RNA 3'末端的跨物种图谱揭示转录终止机制特征与进化规律
summary.enzyme_type: 本文不涉及RNase III或dsRNA切割核糖核酸酶（如Class I RNase III、Drosha、Dicer、Mini-III、Rnt1p、Pac1等）；研究对象为细菌转录终止相关机制与RNA 3'末端生成，属于转录终止与RNA加工调控范畴，而非dsRNA内切酶。
summary.mechanism: 该研究通过重新利用RNAtag-seq数据中与3'末端相关的特殊读段模式，构建了32种细菌病原体在10–12种条件下转录本3'末端的“Bacterminome”图谱。序列元件分析在经典内在终止子之外，还鉴定出多种已知和新发现的终止相关序列特征，表明细菌3'末端生成由多样的终止相关元件决定。同源基因的对应3'末端在不同细菌中可采用不同的终止机制，且往往与该物种的主导终止机制相匹配；部分条件依赖性3'末端在物种间具有保守性，提示可变3'末端可能参与基因表达调控。
summary.engineering: 本文未涉及蛋白优化、突变设计、底物特异性重编程、结构域融合或可编程RNA切割等工程化改造；其应用价值在于构建了跨物种、跨条件的细菌转录3'末端资源库，并提供用户友好的网络服务器（https://bacterminome.huji.ac.il），为大规模研究转录终止机制、比较基因组学及潜在诊断/生物技术应用提供平台。
summary.key_results: 构建了覆盖32种人类细菌病原体、10–12种培养条件的Bacterminome图谱，系统揭示了经典内在终止子之外多种已知与新发现的终止相关序列特征。发现同源基因的3'末端终止机制在物种间存在差异且常与物种主导机制一致，同时部分条件依赖性3'末端具有跨物种保守性，支持可变3'末端参与基因表达调控的推测。
